routines.cleanup: Native operations serialize under the process mutex. The shared tracker counts open DAS/DLA links and drains a partially consumed native reader on final close in bounded pages. Tests free all owned handles and transient WASM allocations and remove scratch files in finally.

findings.summary: The public adapter reads a private completion flag even on early errors. Its reader caches a record across files, reserves -1 as a sentinel, and only releases file positions at EOF. Use the linked initialized original extractor and conversion, preflight width against independent real records and drain on last local close. Read the legitimate first writer directly through the linked record reader when its ID collides with the sentinel.
